purpose: Test whether eight active inference slots preserve the Q8 TP1 aggregate sweet spot while the HTTP server queues 16 to 64 simultaneous requests.

prior_qualified_result.profile: 16 active slots, 8192 total context, F16 KV
prior_qualified_result.observation: The stable 16-slot profile loses 34.26% aggregate throughput from 8 to 16 users.

identity.topology: TP1 on one Intel Arc Pro B70

server_profile.requests_above_eight: queued by the server rather than allocated as additional inference slots

pilot.required_output_gate: all sequential and queued responses return 128 complete raw token IDs, cached_tokens=0, and no cross-base oracle collision
pilot.publication_status: pilot only; rates may not be published

next_step_if_passed: Freeze compact 64-row token-ID digests and preregister two fresh-server p8 publication attempts with a <=10% pointwise stability gate.
